title: Everything You Need
subtitle: Build feature-rich editors without the bloat. Pick what you need, leave the rest.

frameworkAgnostic.title: Framework Agnostic
frameworkAgnostic.description: First-class support for React, Vue, and Svelte. Use the same editor engine everywhere.

richTextEditing.title: Rich Text Editing
richTextEditing.description: Bold, italic, headings, lists, code blocks, and more. Powered by ProseMirror for rock-solid reliability.

markdownSupport.title: Markdown Support
markdownSupport.description: Parse Markdown into rich text and serialize back, including GFM tables. Lossy cases are documented.

tableEditing.title: Table Editing
tableEditing.description: Create and edit tables with column resizing, row/column operations, and header support.

notionStyle.title: Notion-Style UI
notionStyle.description: Slash commands with keyboard navigation and a floating bubble toolbar for a lighter, Notion-inspired writing flow.

aiReady.title: AI Ready
aiReady.description: Hooks for your own AI backend: stream generated text into the document and cancel it cleanly.
